title: Set CRON_ENDPOINT as a GitHub repository variable
body: Add CRON_ENDPOINT as a repository variable in GitHub Settings > Variables > Actions. It should point to the production app URL (e.g., the Vercel deployment URL).
rationale: The workflow guard check still exits with code 1 if CRON_ENDPOINT is unset. Once the code fix is merged, the repository variable must be configured for the workflow to succeed.
